summary: A 100-foot Perry County lookout in Hoosier National Forest that is gone; a June 2024 visit found no tower bases at the old site.

facts.design: 100-foot tower with a latrine, per the Forest Service list
facts.status_note: Not standing. A June 2024 visit found no tower bases at the old site.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Hoosier National Forest (Lafayette district, now Tell City)

access.note: Hoosier National Forest land. The Indiana Fire Towers author stopped at the Buzzard Roost Overlook, in the same section as the old tower site, in June 2024.

visit.trail_note: The author walked around the weedy clearing near the old site for a few minutes and saw no tower bases. The overlook nearby gives views of the Ohio River.

events.note: June 2024 visit: weedy clearing near where the tower would have been; no tower bases found.

notes_for_editor: Almost no history survives in the sources read: no build date, no removal date, no staffing. The Forest Service list gives 100 feet (30.5 m); the record's height_m was empty. A search snippet attributed a 1973 teardown and a longtime employee to a Prism News article, but that page returned HTTP 503 and the claim is unverified, so it is left out. The easternus Buzzard Roost page has only a title and no body text.
